items.title: Ernest McLean Interview, 1959-05-27
items.q: And Edgar was the other guitar player. Yeah. Edgar got his own band and... I was in my Natal, I think.

ctx.x: Remember the names of the other fellows that were in the group?
Well, we had Dawgert Dawson and Vibes. Stuart Davis, played bass with us. And Edgar was the other guitar player. Yeah. Edgar got his own band and... I was in my Natal, I think.
Have you traveled around the country very much?
